{{Quote|Tabac stick?|Safonne Pendon, to the Venithon Twins|<ref name="Offer" />}}
The '''Flyntarian tabac stick''' was a type of [[tabac stick]] that originated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Flyntaria system/Legends|Flyntaria system]]. At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], [[Safonne Pendon]], the leader of a [[Pendon's pirates|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], offered several Flyntarian [[Tabac/Legends|tabac]] sticks to the [[Venithon Twins]], two pirates of the rival [[Hy'thor Group]], while the trio discussed a truce aboard Pendon's [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Safonne's Sword]]''. During the conversation, one of the [[Twin/Legends|twins]], [[Dorin Venithon|Dorin]], and Pendon himself both [[Smoking/Legends|smoked]] a tabac stick.

==Description==
The Flyntarian tabac stick was a type of expensive [[tabac stick]]<ref name="Offer" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Flyntaria system/Legends|Flyntaria system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:Safonne_Pendon.png|thumb|right|250px|Safonne Pendon kept a number of Flyntarian tabac sticks in his office.]]
[[Safonne Pendon]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] leader of a [[Pendon's pirates|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated in<ref name="Offer" /> the Outer Rim's<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]], kept several Flyntarian [[Tabac/Legends|tabac]] sticks in the top drawer of a bureau he kept in his office aboard his<ref name="Offer" /> personal<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]], ''[[Safonne's Sword]]''. Pendon used an [[autoigniter]] to light the tabac sticks and used a refuse chute on the side of his desk to dispose of them when they had [[Fire/Legends|burned]] out.<ref name="Offer" />

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', which includes "[[An Offer They Couldn't Refuse]]," represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] pirate [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Denuab Venithon|Denuab]] and [[Dorin Venithon|Dorin]]&mdash;known as the [[Venithon Twins]]&mdash;visited the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] in order to negotiate a truce on behalf of their employer and Pendon's rival, [[Ompiach]] of the [[Hy'thor Group]]. The Venithons were taken to Pendon's office, where, after seating themselves opposite the pirate leader, the Rodian offered them Flyntarian tabac sticks&mdash;one for each of the [[Gender/Legends|brothers']] two [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]]. While Denuab politely declined the offer, Dorin accepted one of the tabac sticks and, after it was lighted, [[Smoking/Legends|puffed]] it while being irritated at Pendon's confidence in his situation in the negotiation. The Rodian himself also smoked a tabac stick, with it becoming nearly burned-out during the course of the conversation between him and the Ithorians.<ref name="Offer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flyntarian tabac sticks appeared in "[[An Offer They Couldn't Refuse]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Offer" />
